synctang

Personal F-Droid repository publishing signed synctang releases, built automatically in CI from commits and tags. synctang unlocks a LUKS volume at boot by asking a human's phone, which holds its key in the Android Keystore and never discloses it.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://muelli.github.io/synctang/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
